newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Were rates QNI a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Were rates QNI a buy.

text.p: Melbourne brokerage J.B. Were and Son said it was rating nickel producer QNI Ltd a buy as the company had demonstrated the ability to generate significant earnings from its existing business.
QNI also had a number of capital projects underway, "which are aimed at reducing unit costs, increasing production and generating higher revenues for end products," Were said.
QNI offered good exposure to any potential rise in the nickel price, the broker said in a research report.
"Analysis of market parameters has led to a forecast of steadily improving nickel prices in the next two years," it said.
"Unlike conventional resource stocks, QNI does not offer exploration upside, however, it does have a significant competitive advantage in its proven process," it said.
"This gives QNI a real advantage in the development of tropical nickel ores and also gives QNI attractive growth opportunities with very low competition."
J.B. Were forecast QNI's net profit would be A$84.6 million in the year to June 30, 1997, down from A$85.9 million in 1995/96 beceause of a higher tax rate.
Profits would then rise to A$135.3 million in 1997/98.
QNI's shares were down six cents at A$2.66 2.20 p.m. (0420 GMT).
